name: Smartworld The Edition
summary: Project, developer, RERA number, land area, towers/units and unit size range are confirmed. Every independent source places the project in Sector 66 (Golf Course Extension Road / Badshahpur), not Sector 68 as we publish. Starting price is within tolerance; the RERA possession date (Feb 2031) is available but not published by us.

checks.web: Smart World The Edition, ultra-luxury residential project on Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram
Smart World Group / Smartworld Developers; RERA promoter reported as ETSY Realcon Pvt Ltd
checks.note: Brand matches; registered promoter entity is reportedly ETSY Realcon Private Limited (Smartworld group company).

checks.ours: Sector 68, Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 68, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Sector 66, Golf Course Extension Road (Badshahpur, near Marbella Villas), Gurugram
checks.note: All sources found (portals, broker and developer-affiliated pages) say Sector 66; none say Sector 68. Slug also carries the wrong sector.

checks.web: Under construction (launched Nov 2023); some portals still label it 'New Launch'
RERA possession 28 Feb 2031 (another source: 1 Feb 2031); one aggregator lists December 2027
checks.note: We do not publish possession; the RERA date is available. Sources disagree on the day; the Dec 2027 figure looks unreliable.

checks.web: ~₹5.45 Cr (3 BHK) onwards; Houssed ₹6 Cr – ₹7.2 Cr
